# The run-time checks of the fast call path reach it only in a binary built
# with GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo: without it the same calls take the plain cgo
# path and pass. This script turns the experiment on and fails if any of the
# five tests skips or does not run.
[!cgo] skip 'needs cgo'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go test -v -count=1 -run '^(TestFastcallBlockingParity|TestFastcallSigprofSurvives|TestFastcallProfileAttribution|TestFastcallNoCallbackViolation|TestFastcallPinStackUnderCollection)$' cmd/cgo/internal/testlogos
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallBlockingParity'
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallSigprofSurvives'
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallProfileAttribution'
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallNoCallbackViolation'
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallPinStackUnderCollection'
! stdout 'SKIP'
stdout '^ok\s+cmd/cgo/internal/testlogos'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/fastcallruntime

go 1.27
